_comment: Administrative master extract used for cross-database verification, sourced from real Local Government Directory (LGD) data. States/districts/tehsils are real LGD codes and names for the districts covered. Villages are a bounded, representative subset per tehsil (capped and deduplicated), not the full village count - a real revenue village not listed here should not be treated as invalid, only unverifiable against this bundle.
source: Local Government Directory (LGD), Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India (lgdirectory.gov.in), via the community CSV mirror at github.com/planemad/india-local-government-directory. Cross-published on data.gov.in as "Local Government Directory (LGD) - Villages".
